unifi_new_device_trigger.description: Runs for each new device in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_host_trigger.description: Runs for each new host in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_or_updated_device_trigger.description: Runs for each device added or changed in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_or_updated_host_trigger.description: Runs for each host added or changed in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_or_updated_sd_wan_configuratio.description: Runs for each SD-WAN configuration added or changed in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_or_updated_site_trigger.description: Runs for each site added or changed in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_sd_wan_configuration_trigger.description: Runs for each new SD-WAN configuration in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

unifi_new_site_trigger.description: Runs for each new site in UniFi. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
